overview_description.description:
Kapacity.io is building the future of smart energy grids with an electricity Load Balancing service focused on buildings.

By shifting electricity consumption to periods of lower electricity prices and higher renewable energy production, our customers pay less for electricity and emit less CO2 in their buildings. By combining these buildings into a Virtual Power Plant, Kapacity.io also participates in power grid balancing to help keep our lights on during moments of high energy demand.

about_short_description.short_description: Reducing energy costs & emissions in buildings

product.name: Kapacity.io Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based platform that connects and controls internet-connected heat pumps to optimize energy consumption and costs.

product.name: Smart Heat Pump Optimization Service
product.description: A service that automatically adjusts heat pump operation to reduce energy costs and emissions by leveraging electricity price signals and weather data.

product.name: Demand Response Service
product.description: A service that enables buildings to adjust electricity consumption dynamically to balance grid demand and earn incentives.

product.name: Hot Water Boost Feature
product.description: A feature that schedules hot water heating based on dynamic electricity prices to reduce costs without affecting user comfort.

identifier.value: Fleet Management for Installers and Asset Managers

product.name: Fleet Management for Installers and Asset Managers
product.description: A cloud-based tool for installers and property managers to monitor and analyze the performance of multiple heat pump devices across buildings.
